name: Akumade, Kore wa ~ no Monogatari
original_name: あくまで、これは～の物語
source:
Jouichi has been constantly moving and changing schools because of his parent’s work, so he never really made many friends nor had a girlfriend. A few years ago, one of his best friends committed suicide. He never really understood the truth behind it and hoped to solve it one day.

Now he lives in a village in the heart of the mountains, which prospers from the many tourists that visit the region by shinkansen. With the arrival of summer, the town was in a festival mood. Jouichi and his childhood friend Emi helped out with setting up the grounds, meeting the quiet Kana, lively Hinami and gentle onee-san Yukari. There was also one other thing that occurred at that time. When Emi was showing him how to use the chat program NEEL on his new smartphone, it vibrated as he received a notification message. It was a friend request from their friend who should have been dead.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/03/15/march-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri[/url]]
translation:
由于父母工作的原因，城一经常搬家、换学校，所以他从来没有真正交过很多朋友，也没有女朋友。几年前，他最好的朋友之一自杀了。他从来没有真正了解过这背后的真相，并希望有一天能够解决它。

现在他住在山区中心的一个村庄，该村庄因乘坐新干线游览该地区的众多游客而繁荣。随着夏季的到来，小镇里洋溢着节日的气氛。城一和青梅竹马的惠美帮忙布置场地，结识了安静的加奈、活泼的日南和温柔的姐姐由香里。当时还发生了另外一件事。当Emi向他展示如何使用新智能手机上的聊天程序NEEL时，他收到一条通知消息，该程序震动了。这是他们本来应该死掉的朋友发出的好友请求。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/03/15/march-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri[/url]]
